title: Astro's GitHub issue backlog is heading to zero for the first time in 5 years. Now Cloudflare is open-sourcing the tool that did it.
author: Paul Sawers
zh_title: Astro的GitHub Issue积压量创5年新低，Cloudflare正式开源其背后的自动化工具
zh_summary: 开源框架Astro利用AI代理系统triagebot-action，自动化处理GitHub Issue，成功将积压问题降至个位数。Cloudflare已将该工具开源，旨在帮助维护者解决耗时的分类与诊断任务。
